problem:
Calculate the minor of the entry ${p}_{32}$ in the matrix
$P=[\begin{aligned}8 & 8 & 4 \\ -5 & 4 & 6 \\ 10 & 3 & 0\end{aligned}].$
worked_solution:
The minor of ${p}_{32}=3$ (third row, second column) is the determinant of the remaining entries when the column and row containing $3$ are removed: 

$$
P=[\begin{aligned}8 & ∗ & 4 \\ -5 & ∗ & 6 \\ ∗ & 3 & ∗\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor of ${p}_{32}=3$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{det}[\begin{aligned}8 & 4 \\ -5 & 6\end{aligned}] & =|\begin{aligned}8 & 4 \\ -5 & 6\end{aligned}| \\  & =8\cdot 6-4\cdot (-5) \\  & =48+20 \\  & =68.\end{aligned}
$$
